name: Cortelazor (Spain)
description: Divided by two diagonal lines from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red at the upper hoist, white in the centre and yellow at the lower fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Cortelazor (a bird on red).
history: Municipal flag of Cortelazor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: area at the upper hoist bounded by a diagonal from the upper edge to the lower hoist
area at the lower fly bounded by a diagonal from the upper fly to the lower edge
